pageSubtitle: Find answers to common questions about Logic Indicators, our plans, tools, payments, and licensing. If you can't find what you're looking for, contact us and we'll be happy to help.

items.a:
Logic Indicators is a professional indicator suite for NinjaTrader 8, designed for traders who use Order Flow, Footprint, and volume analysis in their daily trading.

We combine high-performance tools with a practical and intuitive configuration system, allowing you to achieve professional-grade setups easily through presets and pre-configured templates, without having to configure every single element from scratch.

items.q: Do I need prior trading experience?
items.a:
The tools are primarily designed for intermediate or advanced traders. If you already trade with Order Flow and understand concepts like delta, volume, and absorption, you'll be able to get the most out of the tools from day one.

However, if you're still developing your experience, feel free to contact us. We'll gladly guide you on which of our tools are most suitable for you, based on your level and learning curve.

items.q: Which platforms are the indicators compatible with?
items.a:
Our indicators are developed and compiled exclusively for NinjaTrader 8 using NinjaScript (C#).

They are currently not compatible with NinjaTrader 7, TradingView, MetaTrader, or any other trading platform.

items.q: Do I need a NinjaTrader 8 license to use Logic Indicators?
items.a:
No. You don't need to purchase the Lifetime license of NinjaTrader 8 to use our tools.

Logic Indicators are standalone developments and do not depend on NinjaTrader's native Order Flow suite.

items.q: Is Level 2 (Level II) market data required to use the tools?
items.a:
In most cases, no.

Logic Profile, Logic Footprint, Logic Algorithms, Logic Big Trades, and Logic Analytics work with Level 1 (Level I) data, available through live accounts, demo accounts, or prop firm accounts.

Liquidity Map tools do require Level 2 (Market Depth) data, as they rely on full order book depth.

Logic Indicators does not provide market data feeds. Each user must subscribe to and manage their own data provider.

items.q: Do the tools use Tick Replay?
items.a:
No. Logic Indicators tools are designed to operate without needing to enable Tick Replay.

This significantly reduces resource consumption and provides a smoother experience, with lower RAM and CPU usage.

Depending on your computer, chart count, and configuration, our tools can deliver up to 10x better performance compared to solutions that require Tick Replay.

items.q: What are the minimum system requirements for my computer?
items.a:
As a reference, we recommend meeting NinjaTrader 8 system requirements:

• 64-bit processor, 3 GHz or higher.
• 16 GB RAM or more.
• DirectX 10 compatible graphics card or higher.
• Solid State Drive (SSD).
• 64-bit Windows operating system.

Logic Indicators does not require Tick Replay, which contributes to lower resource consumption and better overall performance.

items.q: Can I try the indicators for free before buying?
items.a:
Yes. We offer several free indicators that you can download from the Free Indicators section.

They are fully functional tools built with the exact same technical standard as the rest of Logic Indicators, so you can evaluate our quality before making a purchase.

items.q: Do I receive educational materials to learn how to use the tools?
items.a:
Yes. When you purchase Logic Indicators, you get access to installation and setup guides, video tutorials, and supporting documentation for each tool.

In addition, our preconfigured templates allow you to set up complete charts quickly and easily, even with a single click.

Yes. We provide free, unlimited technical support to our users through the Logic Indicators Discord server.

You can open a ticket to ask questions regarding installation, configuration, or tool operation. You can also request assistance when updating your tools to newly released versions.

items.q: What happens after making a payment?
items.a:
Once your payment is processed, you will receive a confirmation email with instructions to complete your registration. You will need to provide your Machine ID and the details required to create your account.

You will then receive instructions to access your Member Dashboard, where you can download your tools, join the Discord community, and access all installation guides.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a:
We accept credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, and American Express) through Lemon Squeezy, as well as PayPal.

All transactions use 256-bit SSL encryption to ensure your information remains completely secure.

items.q: Are there financing or installment options available?
items.a:
Yes. We offer financing options for our lifetime plans with interest-free monthly installments.

Check out the available options at the bottom of the pricing cards for the Basic Lifetime Pack and Plus Lifetime Pack.

items.q: What does the Lifetime plan include?
items.a:
It is a one-time payment or installment plan that provides permanent access to the indicators included in your plan, along with all future updates and improvements to those tools at no extra charge.

New tools developed in the future are not included, but as a Logic Indicators customer, you will enjoy special discounted rates to add them to your suite.

items.q: What is the difference between the annual plan and the lifetime plan?
items.a:
The annual plan renews every 12 months and includes tool updates throughout that period.

The lifetime plan is a one-time payment that provides permanent access to updates for the tools included in your plan. Therefore, it delivers the highest value for traders planning to use the tools long term.

items.q: Can I use the license on multiple computers?
items.a:
The license is tied to your NinjaTrader 8 Machine ID and can only be active on one machine at a time.

If you switch computers, you can transfer your license by deactivating it on the previous machine from your User Dashboard and subsequently activating it on the new one.

In exceptional cases, we may consider a refund within 30 days of purchase if significant technical issues arise that cannot be resolved with our support team's assistance.

To request a refund, you must provide evidence of the issue and cooperate with our team during the troubleshooting process.

Refunds are not granted for change of mind, issues caused by third-party software such as NinjaTrader, or incompatible non-standard setups.
